# Crossplane XRD + Composition: `XBuckets` composite with S3, RDS, IAM

## XRD — `definition.yaml`

```yaml
apiVersion: apiextensions.crossplane.io/v1
kind: CompositeResourceDefinition
metadata:
  name: xversionedbuckets.platform.example.com
spec:
  group: platform.example.com
  names:
    kind: XVersionedBucket
    plural: xversionedbuckets
  claimNames:
    kind: VersionedBucket
    plural: versionedbuckets
  versions:
  - name: v1alpha1
    served: true
    referenceable: true
    schema:
      openAPIV3Schema:
        type: object
        properties:
          spec:
            type: object
            properties:
              region:
                type: string
                default: us-east-1
              environment:
                type: string
                enum: [dev, prod]
                default: dev
              dbInstanceClass:
                type: string
                default: db.t3.micro
              dbMultiAZ:
                type: boolean
                default: false
              dbStorageGB:
                type: integer
                default: 20
              oidcProvider:
                type: string
                description: EKS OIDC provider URL for IAM trust
              serviceAccountNamespace:
                type: string
                default: app
              serviceAccountName:
                type: string
                default: app-sa
            required: [environment, oidcProvider]
```

## Composition — `composition.yaml`

```yaml
apiVersion: apiextensions.crossplane.io/v1
kind: Composition
metadata:
  name: xversionedbuckets.platform.example.com
  labels:
    provider: aws
spec:
  compositeTypeRef:
    apiVersion: platform.example.com/v1alpha1
    kind: XVersionedBucket
  mode: Pipeline
  pipeline:
  - step: patch-and-transform
    functionRef:
      name: function-patch-and-transform
    input:
      apiVersion: pt.fn.crossplane.io/v1beta1
      kind: Resources
      resources:

      # ── S3 Bucket: versioning, encryption, no public access ──
      - name: bucket
        base:
          apiVersion: s3.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
          kind: Bucket
          spec:
            forProvider:
              region: us-east-1
              forceDestroy: false
        patches:
        - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
          fromFieldPath: spec.region
          toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.region

      - name: bucket-versioning
        base:
          apiVersion: s3.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
          kind: BucketVersioning
          spec:
            forProvider:
              region: us-east-1
              bucketSelector:
                matchControllerRef: true
              versioningConfiguration:
                - status: Enabled
        patches:
        - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
          fromFieldPath: spec.region
          toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.region

      - name: bucket-encryption
        base:
          apiVersion: s3.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
          kind: BucketServerSideEncryptionConfiguration
          spec:
            forProvider:
              region: us-east-1
              bucketSelector:
                matchControllerRef: true
              rule:
                - applyServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
                    - sseAlgorithm: AES256
        patches:
        - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
          fromFieldPath: spec.region
          toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.region

      - name: bucket-public-access-block
        base:
          apiVersion: s3.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
          kind: BucketPublicAccessBlock
          spec:
            forProvider:
              region: us-east-1
              bucketSelector:
                matchControllerRef: true
              blockPublicAcls: true
              blockPublicPolicy: true
              ignorePublicAcls: true
              restrictPublicBuckets: true
        patches:
        - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
          fromFieldPath: spec.region
          toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.region

      # ── RDS PostgreSQL: deletion protection, backups, private ──
      - name: db-subnet-group
        base:
          apiVersion: rds.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
          kind: SubnetGroup
          spec:
            forProvider:
              region: us-east-1
              subnetIdRefs: []  # supply via environment patch map or extra field
        patches:
        - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
          fromFieldPath: spec.region
          toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.region

      - name: postgres
        base:
          apiVersion: rds.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
          kind: Instance
          spec:
            forProvider:
              region: us-east-1
              engine: postgres
              engineVersion: "16.3"
              instanceClass: db.t3.micro
              allocatedStorage: 20
              deletionProtection: true
              publiclyAccessible: false
              backupRetentionPeriod: 7
              autoGeneratePassword: true
              username: appuser
              passwordSecretRef:
                key: password
                name: app-db-credentials  # managed by secret store; overridden below
        patches:
        - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
          fromFieldPath: spec.region
          toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.region
        - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
          fromFieldPath: spec.dbInstanceClass
          toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.instanceClass
        - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
          fromFieldPath: spec.dbStorageGB
          toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.allocatedStorage
        - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
          fromFieldPath: spec.environment
          toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.multiAz
          transforms:
          - type: map
            map:
              dev: false
              prod: true
        - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
          fromFieldPath: spec.environment
          toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.storageEncrypted
          transforms:
          - type: map
            map:
              dev: false
              prod: true
        # Publish generated password to a connection secret (encrypted by
        # External Secrets / Vault backend — never plaintext in Git)
        - type: ToCompositeFieldPath
          fromFieldPath: status.atProvider.address
          toFieldPath: status.dbEndpoint

      # ── IAM Role: OIDC trust for service account, least privilege ──
      - name: sa-role
        base:
          apiVersion: iam.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
          kind: Role
          spec:
            forProvider:
              assumeRolePolicy: |
                {
                  "Version": "2012-10-17",
                  "Statement": [{
                    "Effect": "Allow",
                    "Principal": {"Federated": "${oidc}"},
                    "Action": "sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity",
                    "Condition": {
                      "StringEquals": {
                        "${oidc}:sub": "system:serviceaccount:${ns}:${sa}"
                      }
                    }
                  }]
                }
        patches:
        - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
          fromFieldPath: spec.oidcProvider
          toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.assumeRolePolicy
          transforms:
          - type: string
            string:
              type: Format
              fmt: |
                {
                  "Version": "2012-10-17",
                  "Statement": [{
                    "Effect": "Allow",
                    "Principal": {"Federated": "arn:aws:iam::123456789012:oidc-provider/%s"},
                    "Action": "sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity",
                    "Condition": {
                      "StringEquals": {
                        "%s:sub": "system:serviceaccount:%s:%s"
                      }
                    }
                  }]
                }
          # Note: multi-value formatting requires repeated patches in practice;
          # alternative shown below with CombineFromComposite.

      - name: sa-role-policy
        base:
          apiVersion: iam.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
          kind: RolePolicy
          spec:
            forProvider:
              roleSelector:
                matchControllerRef: true
              policy: |
                {
                  "Version": "2012-10-17",
                  "Statement": [{
                    "Effect": "Allow",
                    "Action": [
                      "s3:GetObject",
                      "s3:PutObject"
                    ],
                    "Resource": "*"
                  }]
                }
        patches:
        # Least privilege: scope S3 actions to this bucket only
        - type: CombineFromComposite
          combine:
            variables:
            - fromFieldPath: metadata.name
            strategy: string
            string:
              fmt: |
                {
                  "Version": "2012-10-17",
                  "Statement": [{
                    "Effect": "Allow",
                    "Action": ["s3:GetObject", "s3:PutObject", "s3:ListBucket"],
                    "Resource": [
                      "arn:aws:s3:::%s-assets",
                      "arn:aws:s3:::%s-assets/*"
                    ]
                  }]
                }
          toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.policy
```

### Function install (prereq)

```yaml
apiVersion: pkg.crossplane.io/v1
kind: Function
metadata:
  name: function-patch-and-transform
spec:
  package: xpkg.upbound.io/crossplane-contrib/function-patch-and-transform:v0.8.2
```

### Claim usage

```yaml
apiVersion: platform.example.com/v1alpha1
kind: VersionedBucket
metadata:
  name: app-assets
  namespace: dev
spec:
  environment: dev
  region: us-east-1
  dbInstanceClass: db.t3.micro
  oidcProvider: oidc.eks.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/id/EXAMPLE123
```

**Notes:**
- Environment isolation: each claim (dev/prod namespace) instantiates independent composites; prod sizing via `dbInstanceClass`, `dbMultiAZ` parameters.
- The OIDC trust policy formatting with multiple substitutions is more cleanly done with `CombineFromComposite` (same pattern as the RolePolicy patch); shown both ways for reference.
- DB password uses `autoGeneratePassword` with the secret written to the Crossplane connection secret, consumed by External Secrets/Vault (criterion 3: no plaintext in Git).
